Evolution!

October 23, 2005

I am evolving!
I have given in to ignorance!
Everyone is more beautiful and much dumber.
It’s easier to fuck around with myself now.
Die you narcissistic World!
I am just one of you.
Run away while my intentions are still nebulous!
I “might” be lethal today.
Keep Vodka off my hands! [evil grin…]
